children: The Tokyo Regional Taxation Bureau identified about $24.5 million in unreported crypto-asset income among 91 users during investigations in the previous fiscal year. According to Odaily, the omissions totaled about 3.9 billion yen, and authorities assessed about 1.2 billion yen, or approximately $7.5 million, in additional taxes. Investigators used large-scale transaction data to identify potential tax evaders. Japan’s tax authorities plan to add staff specializing in digital-transaction investigations and, starting in 2027, further strengthen the exchange of crypto-asset transaction information with overseas tax authorities.

title: Tokyo Tax Bureau Finds About $24.5 Million in Crypto Reporting Omissions Among 91 Users
